decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-09-05), but no activity since, no invite sent, and no reply to two outreach emails (email:b2182c73, email:8c5701af). Zero tickets means no engagement signal either. Single-user Starter account with 8 days left; unaided activation looks unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my last note — no reply needed if things are just busy. You've already created your first project in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. A common next step is bringing in a teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whichever next step matters most to Lantern Systems.

Best,
Chidi
